description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SavingsAccountChargeCannotBeWaivedException' with an embedded enum 'SavingsAccountChargeCannotBeWaivedReason' that specifies reasons why a savings account charge cannot be waived, along with methods to retrieve error messages and codes based on these reasons.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeCannotBeWaivedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a savings account charge cannot be waived, with contextual reasons provided by an enum.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeCannotBeWaivedReason
classes.description: Enumeration of reasons why a savings account charge cannot be waived, with methods to get associated error messages and codes.

methods.name: SavingsAccountChargeCannotBeWaivedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific reason and charge ID.

methods.name: errorMessage
